title: The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to incorrect authorization in all… (CVE-2026-2841)
description: The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) plugin for WordPress contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in all versions up to and including 6.7.0. This flaw allows authenticated users with Subscriber-level access or higher to inject arbitrary query parameters due to lack of validation in the 'ACF_Ajax_Query::get_args' method. Exploitation can lead to bypassing role restrictions and exfiltration of sensitive user data such as administrator email addresses, login names, and private metadata.
